BoolProp.name: Affected by fog (if any)
BoolProp.doc: Whether this material is affected by fog (if there is fog in this track)

BoolProp.name: Affected by lights
BoolProp.doc: Whether this material is affected by lights and shadows

BoolProp.name: Backface Culling
BoolProp.doc: If checked, this material will only be visible on the side of the normal

BoolProp.name: Below shallow water
BoolProp.doc: Used for the terrain under shallow water where you can drive

BoolProp.name: Clamp texture horizontally
BoolProp.doc: if checked, this texture will not be repeated horizontally (if the UV texturing goes beyond the texture bounds)

BoolProp.name: Clamp texture vertically
BoolProp.doc: if checked, this texture will not be repeated vertically (if the UV texturing goes beyond the texture bounds)

BoolProp.name: Collision action
BoolProp.doc: What happens when the kart touches/hits this material in any way

EnumProp.name: Action
EnumProp.doc: How to react when kart touches this material

EnumProp.name: Compositing Type
EnumProp.doc: How to composite this texture with what is behind it

EnumChoice.label: Alpha Blend
EnumChoice.doc: Use transparency on this texture, using the alpha channel or a specified external mask

EnumChoice.label: Alpha Test
EnumChoice.doc: Use fully-opaque-or-fully-transparent transparency on this texture, using the alpha channel or a specified external mask

EnumChoice.label: Alpha to Coverage
EnumChoice.doc: Like alpha testing but with softer edges

EnumChoice.label: Additive Blending
EnumChoice.doc: Brighten up anything under by adding the current color on top (useful for fire or light)

BoolProp.name: Disable writing to Z-buffer
BoolProp.doc: disable writing to the Z buffer (useful for materials with transparency, if irrlicht fails to do proper alpha sorting, in order not to hide what is behind)

BoolProp.name: Enable Slowdow
BoolProp.doc: Whether to slow down the kart when driving on this material

FloatProp.name: Slowdown Time (seconds)
FloatProp.doc: Time it takes for speed to drop to its low point when driving here

FloatProp.name: Maximum Speed (fraction)
FloatProp.doc: Fraction of the maximum speed can be reached when driving here

BoolProp.name: Falling Effect
BoolProp.doc: Whether this material is the bottom of a pit (then camera will look down at kart falling when over it)

BoolProp.name: High tires adhesion
BoolProp.doc: If checked, karts will have good grip on this surface and not slip, even at angles

BoolProp.name: Ignore (ghost material)
BoolProp.doc: Drive through this texture like it didn't exist (good for smoke, etc.)

BoolProp.name: Lightmap is additive
BoolProp.doc: Make lightmap additive (only makes sense if this material has a lightmap)

StringProp.name: Mask image
StringProp.doc: Greyscale image containing the alpha channel (transparency) for this image

BoolProp.name: Normal Map
BoolProp.doc: Use normal maps for this material (the model must be exported as tangent for this to work)

StringProp.name: Normal Map Image
StringProp.doc: Image containing the normal map for this texture

StringProp.name: Light Map Image
StringProp.doc: Image containing the lightmap for this texture (optional)

BoolProp.name: Particle effect
BoolProp.doc: Whether to emit particles (e.g. smoke) when driving on this surface

StringProp.name: Particles file
StringProp.doc: Name of the XML file containing the description of particles to use on this terrain

BoolProp.name: Play sound effect
BoolProp.doc: Whether to play a sound when driving on this surface

FloatProp.name: Sound pitch at min speed
FloatProp.doc: Pitch of the sound when the kart is going slowly (1.0 is no change, < 1.0 is lower pitch, > 1.0 is higher pitch)

FloatProp.name: Sound pitch at max speed
FloatProp.doc: Pitch of the sound when the kart is going fastly (1.0 is no change, < 1.0 is lower pitch, > 1.0 is higher pitch)

BoolProp.name: Positional sound effect
BoolProp.doc: If true, the sound will get dimmer when far from camera, and with panning; if false, it's heard at centered pan and at full volume

FloatProp.name: Rolloff rate
FloatProp.doc: Speed at which the sound fades out as you stand further from the sound emitter

BoolProp.name: Reset kart (on drive)
BoolProp.doc: whether to rescue kart if it ends up [driving] on this surface

BoolProp.name: Sphere mapping
BoolProp.doc: use sphere mapping on this object (mainly used to simulate a reflection effect)

BoolProp.name: Splatting
BoolProp.doc: Use splatting (multiple textures with smooth transitions)

BoolProp.name: Surface
BoolProp.doc: whether this material is the surface of a water area

BoolProp.name: Water Shader
BoolProp.doc: If checked, a shader will simulate light reflexions and moving waves on this surface

BoolProp.name: Zipper (speed boost)
BoolProp.doc: Whether to get a speed boost when driving on this surface
